assumptions.activity: Light metabolic activity (~1.0 met / 100 W/m² seated/resting)
assumptions.clothing: Light summer attire (~0.5 clo thermal insulation)
assumptions.shelter: Unconditioned shaded structure, natural ventilation target
assumptions.calculationMethod: Steadman Heat Index modified by convective wind & radiant solar factors
assumptions.limitations: Prototype heuristic comfort model for conceptual guidance; NOT a certified ASHRAE-55 / ISO-7730 PMV calculation.

roofType.reason: Provides balanced runoff and weather protection.
roofType.expectedBenefit: Reduces radiant heat gain through the roof plane by 30-40%.

ventilation.reason: Sufficient air exchange for indoor air quality.
ventilation.expectedBenefit: Preserves internal warmth and prevents drafty infiltration.

openings.reason: Provides adequate daylight and moderate ventilation.
openings.expectedBenefit: Protects internal thermal mass from external extremes.

shading.trigger: Solar Exposure Low / Site Exposure Open
shading.reason: Direct solar irradiance through unshaded glazing sharply spikes operative internal temperature.
shading.expectedBenefit: Blocks direct solar radiation on east/west facades during peak heat hours.

overhang.reason: Shades vertical wall surfaces from high noon sun angles.
overhang.expectedBenefit: Keeps walls dry and shades perimeter windows.

raisedFloor.reason: Standard slab on grade ground contact.
raisedFloor.expectedBenefit: Eliminates flood risk and enables under-floor cooling airflow.

material.reason: Selected based on thermal mass and local durability fit.
material.expectedBenefit: Suitability score 75/100 with Low cost class.

orientation.value: Long axis East-West; shade East & West facades
orientation.trigger: Peak solar radiation along East-West solar track
orientation.reason: Minimizes solar exposure on short East/West walls while maximizing North/South daylighting.
orientation.expectedBenefit: Reduces peak daily radiant heat accumulation.

structuralConsiderations.reason: Prevents structural erosion and ground settlement.
structuralConsiderations.expectedBenefit: Ensures structural stability and wind load safety.

materials.name: Compressed earth block (CEB)
materials.bestFor: Hot-dry desert, high solar, semi-arid regions

materials.name: Insulated steel sandwich panel
materials.bestFor: Cold mountain, high wind, rapid emergency response
